integrity: The proof is symbolic. A standalone verifier checks valuation-layer formulas, exact resolving sets, exhaustive small metric dimensions, and same-parameter graph profiles for nonisomorphic chain rings.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite commutative chain rings.
Special cases for Z/p^ell Z are already covered by broader Z_n determining/metric results and a separate automorphism calculation.
The 2021 finite-chain-ring spectral paper was inspected only at abstract level because full-text access failed.
title: Annihilator layers control symmetry and metric dimension in every finite chain-ring zero-divisor graph
